reasons.A: Long, smoothly joined sentences, a reflective essayist's 'we' and abstractions like 'how honest a list can be'; nothing of the passage's clipped, flat, dryly funny movement.
reasons.B: Right rhythm of short declaratives and fragments, but it leans lyrical ('Every time a small promise. Every time broken.', 'In the box. One sheet at a time.') and stacks fragments a bit more thickly than the passage does.
reasons.C: Closest match: plain short sentences with occasional fragments ('Like a pulse.'), a matter-of-fact first-person stance, plain words and no contractions, and a dry, understated close in the new-list-goes-up manner.
